digest.en: Trump and Xi meet in Shenzhen with little left to trade. China simultaneously hoards Nvidia chips as US curbs remote access. The Philippines sees hundreds arrested in anti-Trump protests over the Iran war and AI pact.
digest.hi: होर्मुज स्ट्रेट में भारतीय क्रू वाले LPG टैंकर पर मिसाइल हमला हुआ। जेडी वेंस ने ईरान युद्ध को लंबा खींचने की इच्छा जताई।

articles.title: China’s J-10C missile upgrade could become a Taiwan war trap
articles.summary: China's J-10C fighters now carry short-range air-to-surface missiles. This creates a tactical risk if Taiwan's air defenses survive initial strikes. Jets forced closer to target face higher loss rates. The vulnerability mirrors US experiences in Iran. China’s integration of upgraded short-range air-to-surface missiles onto its frontline fighters exposes a critical vulnerability in a Taiwan conflict: if Taiwan’s air defenses survive initial barrages and exhaust China’s long-range stockpiles, jets forced closer with shorter-range weapons risk severe losses, mirroring US experience in Iran.

articles.title: Why is the US targeting Southeast Asia in its bid to curb China's access to AI chips?
articles.summary: The US is tightening AI chip restrictions on Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand. Washington aims to close loopholes used by Chinese firms. The move threatens the region's growing data center industry. Local tech sectors face new compliance hurdles. Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand face tighter US restrictions on advanced AI chips as Washington moves to close a loophole used by Chinese firms.

articles.title: Hundreds arrested in anti-Trump protests in Philippines amid anger over Iran war and AI pact
articles.summary: Hundreds were arrested in Manila during anti-Trump protests. Demonstrations were fueled by anger over the Iran war and a new AI pact. Organizers expect up to 10,000 people to join the next round. Trump is arriving for the Asean summit. Organisers say up to 10,000 people could join the next round of demonstrations ahead of the US president’s arrival in Manila for the Asean summitAsean and Apec summits – live updatesHundreds of people have been arrested in heated demonstrations against Donald Trump in Manila, as authorities braced for more protests ahead of the US president’s arrival in the city for a leaders’ summit. Organisers cl.

articles.title: Trump and Xi meet in Shenzhen with little left to trade
articles.summary: Trump and Xi met in Shenzhen for the APEC summit. Technology policy is now a fixed national security arena, not a bargaining chip. Neither leader has significant concessions to offer. The meeting highlighted the rigid structure of current US-China relations. The November 18-19 APEC summit will reveal a fundamental shift in US-China relations: technology policy is no longer a flexible instrument of presidential bargaining, but an increasingly institutionalized arena of national security competition.

articles.title: China hoards Nvidia’s AI chips as US curbs remote access
articles.summary: Chinese companies are stockpiling Nvidia AI chips and overseas computing racks. Washington is closing export control loopholes and rallying allies. Fears of stricter smuggling regulations drive the rush. Jensen Huang's situation may accelerate new US legislation. Chinese companies are racing to stockpile Nvidia’s artificial intelligence (AI) chips and secure computing racks overseas as Washington closes loopholes in its export controls and rallies allies to guard sensitive technologies.

articles.title: Rio Tinto agrees to pay US$250m to begin repairing ‘devastation’ left by Panguna mine
articles.summary: Rio Tinto agreed to pay 250 million US dollars to start cleaning the toxic Panguna mine site. The Anglo-Australian miner abandoned the copper and gold operation over three decades ago. Community leaders say the fund offers a path to address long-standing environmental and social issues left behind by the mine. Community leader says fund gives chance to find solutions to ‘huge problems we have been living with since the days of the mine’s operation’Anglo-Australian miner Rio Tinto has agreed to pay a quarter-of-a-billion dollars to begin the clean-up of the toxic Panguna mine site it abandoned more than three decades ago. Panguna, once one of the world’s most profitable gold and copper mines, was shuttere.

articles.title: Iranian Top Cleric Visits Bosnia As Tehran Seeks Opening To Europe
articles.summary: A senior Iranian cleric who briefly assumed supreme leader powers after Khamenei's death visited Sarajevo. He urged European nations to distance themselves from US and Israeli policies toward Tehran. The visit highlights Tehran's effort to cultivate a European diplomatic connection. A senior Iranian cleric who briefly helped exercise the powers of Iran's supreme leader following the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has visited Sarajevo, urging European countries to distance themselves from US and Israeli policies toward Tehran.

articles.title: Geopolitics’ midlife crisis
articles.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO following revelations of an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. The scandal wiped out half a trillion dollars in market cap. Nvidia's total decline since October now stands at 1.7 trillion dollars. Last week began with revelations that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had carried out an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. It ended with Huang’s resignation and a cumulative loss of half a trillion dollars in market cap, bringing the total decline since October to $1.7 trillion.

articles.title: With Soaring Prices And Police Crackdowns, Free Time Now Costs Too Much For Tehran's Youth
articles.summary: Tehran's youth face rising costs and police crackdowns on cafes and street gatherings. The economy remains battered by war and fears of renewed fighting. These pressures make socializing increasingly difficult for young people in the capital. With an economy battered by war and fears of renewed fighting, life in Iran’s capital keeps getting tighter. Add a crackdown on the cafes and street gatherings where young people socialize, and Tehran feels like it’s closing in on its youth.

articles.title: ‘An unfulfilled plan helps no one’: Superbug plans have doubled, but few countries are delivering
articles.summary: The World Health Organization reported that superbug plans have doubled globally. However, few countries are actually delivering on these commitments. Major gaps in testing and treatment leave billions of people at continued risk. More countries are drawing up plans to tackle antimicrobial resistance (AMR), but major gaps in testing and treatment mean billions of people continue to be at risk, according to new data released by the World Health Organization (WHO) on Monday.

articles.title: Progress ‘real’ but fragile, as remnants of war wreck young lives
articles.summary: Syria shows undeniable signs of progress two years after the Assad regime fell. Senior UN officials warn that explosive ordnance and winter threaten these gains. Severe funding shortfalls also complicate recovery efforts for young lives. Syria is showing “undeniable signs of progress” nearly two years after the fall of the Assad regime, but explosive ordnance, the approaching winter and severe funding shortfalls threaten those fragile gains, senior UN officials told the Security Council on Monday.

articles.title: COP31 enters decisive week as climate talks face political test and AI initiatives gather pace
articles.summary: COP31 enters its decisive week with new AI and green industrialization initiatives. Negotiators remain deadlocked on finance, fossil fuels, and adaptation. The UN talks face a significant political test in their final stretch. New international initiatives on artificial intelligence and green industrialization showcased technology’s growing role in climate action, even as negotiators remained deadlocked on finance, fossil fuels and adaptation ahead of the final stretch of the UN talks.

articles.title: At his final ASEAN Summit, Guterres upholds cooperation and action on Myanmar
articles.summary: António Guterres urged stronger cooperation with ASEAN and an end to the Myanmar crisis during his final summit in Manila. The UN Secretary-General addressed regional leaders on Monday, emphasizing the need for collective action to resolve the ongoing humanitarian and political situation in Southeast Asia. UN Secretary-General António Guterres underscored the need for stronger collaboration with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and an end to the crisis in Myanmar, in remarks to regional leaders meeting in the Philippine capital Manila on Monday.

articles.title: Eurovision organisers criticise Malaysian removal of LGBT+ footage in first Asian contest
articles.summary: Eurovision organizers expressed surprise and disappointment after Malaysian broadcaster TV3 removed LGBTQ+ imagery from the first Eurovision Asia broadcast. The cuts included footage of Thai drag performers and a gay Philippine jury spokesperson. The European Broadcasting Union criticized the alteration of the original program content for the regional audience. Broadcaster TV3 appears to cut footage of Thai drag performers and gay Philippine jury spokespersonEurovision’s organisers have said they are “surprised and disappointed” that the first Eurovision Asia was altered when it was broadcast in Malaysia, apparently removing LGBTQ+ imagery and people from the show. The European Broadcasting Union (EBU), the alliance of public broadcasters that owns Eurovi.

articles.title: Trump to embark on Asia trip in apparent foreign policy push before end of term
articles.summary: Donald Trump is beginning his first overseas trip since the midterm elections, signaling a renewed focus on foreign policy. He plans to meet with Chinese and Russian counterparts during the visit. Analysts suggest the president may prioritize global affairs as his domestic influence wanes following the Republican midterm results. Experts say US president may lean toward global affairs after domestic influence curtailed in midterm electionsDonald Trump is embarking on his first overseas trip since his Republican party’s thumping midterm repudiation by US voters, in what may herald a renewed focus on foreign policy for the remainder of his presidency. The US president will meet his Chinese and Russian counterparts, Xi Jinping.

articles.title: Delaware hit by rare November tornado
articles.summary: An EF1 tornado struck the Salem Woods neighbourhood in Delaware on Thursday, reaching 160 metres wide. The storm traveled 4.4 miles with peak winds of 100 mph. The National Weather Service confirmed the event, noting no injuries were reported despite the severe weather conditions affecting the region. Meanwhile, severe thunderstorms bring hailstones the size of baseballs in ArgentinaThe National Weather Service in the US has confirmed that an EF1 tornado touched down south-east of Newark in the Salem Woods neighbourhood, Delaware, on Thursday.

articles.title: Central Asia's AI Race: Big Ambitions, Even Bigger Risks
articles.summary: Central Asian governments are pursuing AI hub status while critics highlight financing gaps and reliance on fossil fuels. The region faces transparency issues amid long-standing corruption concerns. These structural weaknesses threaten the viability of their digital infrastructure plans. Across Central Asia, governments are racing to become the next global AI hub. Yet critics are flagging shaky financing, over reliance on dirty power, and a lack of transparency in a region long plagued by corruption.

articles.title: Managing risk on Ukraine’s frontline
articles.summary: The top UN official in Ukraine warns that humanitarian workers face heightened risks on the frontline. Aid providers must balance proximity to affected communities with the dangers of active conflict zones. This operational tension complicates the delivery of essential support to vulnerable populations. Humanitarian workers providing support to communities on the frontline of the war between Ukraine and Russia must balance remaining close to those in need with the heightened risks of operating in a conflict zone, according to the top UN official in Ukraine.

articles.title: Empowering faith and Indigenous leaders to combat hate
articles.summary: Speakers at the Muscat Plan of Action Forum in Oman called for greater empowerment of religious and Indigenous leaders. They argued these figures should act as full partners in conflict prevention, not just receive praise. The forum emphasized the need for active collaboration in addressing hate and division. Religious, traditional and Indigenous leaders need to be empowered to act as full partners in preventing conflict, not just praised for their role, speakers said Sunday at the opening of the Muscat Plan of Action Forum in Oman.

articles.title: Barred By The Taliban, Afghan Girls And Women Now Shut Out Of School In Iran And Pakistan Too
articles.summary: Afghan women seeking education in Iran and Pakistan face growing barriers. Restrictive immigration rules, poverty, and local instability are blocking their access to schools. Many students can no longer continue their studies in exile due to these compounding pressures. Many Afghan girls and women have moved to Iran and Pakistan to pursue their education in high schools and universities. But restrictive immigration policies, poverty, and instability in both countries have made it increasingly difficult for them to continue their studies in exile.

articles.title: Bahrain Says It Intercepted Iranian Attacks As Tehran Claims Strike On US Base
articles.summary: Bahrain intercepted Iranian aerial attacks on November 15 after explosions and sirens sounded across the kingdom. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed the strike targeted a US military installation. Bahraini air defenses destroyed the incoming projectiles during the incident. Bahrain said its air defenses intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks on November 15, after explosions and air raid sirens were reported across the Gulf kingdom and Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed it had targeted a US military installation.

articles.title: Ukraine Says Starshield Restrictions Persist, Hampering Drone Defenses
articles.summary: Ukraine reports that Starshield restrictions remain widespread. These limits hamper the military’s ability to intercept Russian jet-powered drones near the front line. Moscow gains more opportunities to strike Ukrainian targets as a result. Ukraine says restrictions affecting its use of SpaceX’s Starshield satellite communications system remain widespread, hampering the military’s ability to intercept Russian jet-powered attack drones near the front line and giving Moscow additional opportunities to strike Ukrainian targets.

articles.title: Preparing for drought in Central America
articles.summary: Anastacio Martínez Gómez, 73, farms in southwestern Honduras where the Dry Corridor’s unpredictable rains dictate survival. His decades of experience cannot fully offset the region’s intensifying drought cycles. Across Central America, farming families face shrinking yields as seasonal patterns grow erratic. The corridor’s climate volatility now outpaces traditional agricultural knowledge. Across Central America’s so-called Dry Corridor, farming families live at the mercy of the rains.

articles.title: Gideon Rachman on the Risk of World War III
articles.summary: Gideon Rachman, chief foreign affairs commentator at the Financial Times, discussed his new book War Is Interested in You. He spoke with Richard about the risks of current conflicts escalating into a global war. The conversation explored whether today's geopolitical tensions could spin out of control into a wider confrontation. In this episode of Hold Your Fire!, Richard speaks with Gideon Rachman, chief foreign affairs commentator at the Financial Times about his new book, “War Is Interested in You”, and whether today’s conflicts could spin into a global war.

articles.title: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount
articles.summary: The Gulf region remains tense nearly nine months after Israeli and US strikes on Iran. Iran has effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz, disrupting a fifth of global oil shipments. Rising attacks on shipping and failed diplomatic efforts to stop renewed fighting have prompted a UN Security Council meeting at Bahrain's request. Nearly nine months after Israeli and US strikes on Iran set off a regional war, the Gulf remains on a knife edge.

articles.title: ‘नियोकंजर्वेटिव चाहते हैं ईरान युद्ध कभी खत्म न हो’: ट्रम्प नहीं फंसेंगे, उपराष्ट्रपति जेडी वेंस ने
articles.summary: उपराष्ट्रपति जेडी वेंस ने कहा कि ट्रम्प ईरान युद्ध को लंबी आग में नहीं बदलने देंगे। उन्होंने माना कि ऊर्जा कीमतों पर राजनीतिक असर पड़ सकता है। अमेरिकी उपराष्ट्रपति जे. डी. वेंस ने कहा कि, ‘नियोकंजर्वेटिव’ चाहते हैं कि ईरान के खिलाफ युद्ध हमेशा चलने वाला युद्ध बन जाए, लेकिन उन्होंने भरोसा दिलाया कि राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प इस युद्ध में लंबे समय तक उलझे रहने की स्थिति नहीं बनने देंगे। वेंस ने यह भी माना है कि इस युद्ध की वजह से गैस और ऊर्जा की कीमतों के मामले में राजनीतिक कीमत चुकानी पड़ सकती है।

articles.summary: दिल्ली में आयोजित एक कार्यक्रम में अखिलेश यादव सोनिया गांधी के बगल में बैठे। प्रियंका गांधी और रॉबर्ट वाड्रा भी समीप बैठे थे। यह बैठक सीट बंटवारे के विवाद के बीच हुई। समाजवादी पार्टी (सपा) से सीट बंटवारे पर फंसे पेंच के बीच कांग्रेस नेतृत्व ने दिल्ली से सोमवार (17 नवंबर) को बड़ा संदेश दिया. आईटीसी मौर्य होटल में ‘बिलॉन्गिंग: ए जर्नी ऑफ लव’ की लॉन्चिंग कार्यक्रम में सपा प्रमुख अखिलेश यादव सोनिया गांधी के ठीक बगल में पहली पंक्ति में बैठे नजर आए.

articles.summary: तीन टन वजनी कबरा कान ने पिछले छह महीनों में 16 लोगों की जान ले ली। इसे पकड़ने के लिए 200 से अधिक वनकर्मियों की टीम तैनात है। ड्रोन के जरिए जंगल में उसकी लोकेशन तलाशी जा रही है। जंगल में इस वक्त एक ऐसा शिकारी घूम रहा है, जिसके पास न बंदूक है, न कोई हथियार; उसकी ताकत ही उसका सबसे बड़ा खतरा बन गई है.

articles.summary: कावेरी नदी पर मेकेदातु बांध विवाद के बीच डीके शिवकुमार ने एमके स्टालिन पर निशाना साधा। स्टालिन ने किसानों की आजीविका की रक्षा के लिए सभी राजनीतिक दलों को एकजुट होने की अपील की थी। कावेरी नदी पर प्रस्तावित मेकेदातु बांध परियोजना को लेकर तमिलनाडु और कर्नाटक में सियासी नूरा कुश्ती जारी है. इसी बीच तमिलनाुड की विपक्षी पार्टी डीएमके के एक बयान को लेकर कर्नाटक के मुख्यमंत्री डीके शिवकुमार ने एमके स्टालिन पर निशाना साधा है.

articles.title: ट्रम्प, पुतिन, शी एक मंच पर, भारत कहां? ASEAN और क्वाड क्यों पड़ रहे हैं फीके?
articles.summary: नरेंद्र मोदी ने मनीला में आयोजित आसियान शिखर सम्मेलन में हिस्सा लिया। उन्होंने भारत और दक्षिण पूर्व एशियाई देशों के बीच मजबूत होते संबंधों पर बल दिया। एक्ट ईस्ट नीति ने इन रिश्तों को नई गति दी है। भारतीय प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने फिलिपींस की राजधानी मनीला में आयोजित आसियान समिट में हिस्सा लिया। समिट में दुनिया को संबोधित करते हुए पीएम मोदी ने कहा कि भारत और दक्षिण पूर्व एशियाई देशों के संगठन (ASEAN) के बीच संबंध लगातार मजबूत हो रहे हैं।

articles.summary: जम्मू कश्मीर के कुलगाम में सुरक्षाबलों ने आतंकी उमर निसार डार को मार गिराया। नौपुरा मीर बाजार में हुए हमले से पहले का उसका सीसीटीवी फुटेज सामने आया है। लश्कर कमांडर लतीफ की तलाश अभी भी जारी है। जम्मू कश्मीर के कुलगाम में सुरक्षाबलों ने सोमवार को आतंकी उमर निसार डार को मार गिराया. बीते दिनों कुलगाम के नौपुरा मीर बाजार में हुए आतंकी हमले से पहले का उमर का एक सीसीटीवी वीडियो सामने आया है, जिससे आतंकियों की संदिग्ध गतिविधियों का पता चला है.

articles.summary: फिलीपींस की राजधानी मनीला में आयोजित आसियान शिखर सम्मेलन में प्रधानमंत्री मोदी ने भाग लिया। उन्होंने भारत और आसियान देशों के बीच बढ़ती साझेदारी पर जोर दिया। उन्होंने कहा कि अब प्रतियोगिता का नहीं, सहयोग का समय है। PM Modi Address in ASEAN: पीएम मोदी आसियान की बैठक में हिस्सा लेने के लिए फिलीपींस की राजधानी मनीला में हैं. वे इस शिखर सम्मेलन में बोलते हुए भारत और आसियान देशों के बीच के रिश्तों को कमाल का बताया और कहा कि वक्त प्रतियोगिता का नहीं, साथ बढ़ने का है.

articles.summary: रक्षा मंत्रालय अग्निवीरों की शादी पर प्रतिबंध हटाने पर विचार कर रहा है। यह सुविधा चार साल सेवा के बाद दो साल एक्सटेंशन लेने वालों को मिलेगी। पांचवें और छठे साल में शादी की अनुमति मिल सकती है। अग्निवीर योजना में एक और बड़ा बदलाव होने जा रहा है. रक्षा मंत्रालय अब उन अग्निवीरों के लिए शादी पर लगे प्रतिबंध को ढीला करने पर विचार कर रहा है, जो चार साल की सेवा के बाद दो साल का एक्सटेंशन चुनते हैं.

articles.summary: सुप्रीम कोर्ट बार एसोसिएशन ने वकील के खिलाफ अवमानना का मुकदमा दर्ज किया। वकील ने चीफ जस्टिस सूर्यकांत के सामने दुर्व्यवहार किया था। अटॉर्नी जनरल की अनुमति के बाद याचिका दाखिल की गई है। चीफ जस्टिस सूर्यकांत की कोर्ट में कल एक वकील की तरफ से किए गए दुर्व्यवहार के मामले में सुप्रीम कोर्ट बार एसोसिएशन ने अवमानना का मुकदमा दाखिल किया है.
